cases.title: IMM 5475 Authority to Release Personal Information to a Designated Individual - Valid Submission

fields.designated_individual_details: Full contact details and mailing address provided
fields.authorization_scope: Release of personal information and application status updates

narrative_blocks: I, Jane Eleanor Doe, authorize Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) to release information from my application file to the designated individual named in Section B.

This authorization is limited to disclosing information regarding the processing status and documentation contained in application E00293841. The designated individual is not authorized to act as a legal representative or conduct business on my behalf.
I understand that personal information disclosed to the designated individual will be handled in accordance with the Privacy Act.

cases.title: IMM 5475 Authority to Release Personal Information - Missing Client Signature Date

fields.designated_individual_details: Full contact details and mailing address provided
fields.authorization_scope: Release of personal information and application status updates

narrative_blocks: I, John Michael Taylor, authorize IRCC to release personal information from my application file to Alice Margaret Vance.
Section C consent signed by applicant John Michael Taylor; signature date field remains blank and undated.

defect_spec.description: The Form IMM 5475 contains applicant signature but lacks the mandatory signature date in Section C, rendering the release authorization legally invalid.

cases.title: IMM 5475 Authority to Release Personal Information - Unchecked Consent Box in Section C
narrative_blocks: I, Carlos Eduardo Gomez, submit Form IMM 5475 designating Maria Fernanda Gomez to receive information.
Section C consent declaration checkbox is left unchecked and explicit scope of authorized information disclosure is omitted.

defect_spec.description: The Section C consent checkbox was left unchecked and the explicit authorization scope is missing, failing to grant legal consent for releasing personal information.

cases.title: IMM 5475 Authority to Release Personal Information - Scope Mismatch for Legal Representation

fields.designated_individual_address: 101 Bay Street, Suite 400, Toronto, ON M5H 2Y2
fields.designated_individual_role: Paid Legal Representative and Authorized Agent
fields.designated_individual_details: Authorized to act as representative, submit documents, and conduct business
fields.authorization_scope: Full legal representation, submitting applications, conducting business with IRCC, and receiving communications

narrative_blocks: I, David Sun, submit Form IMM 5475 appointing Arthur Pendelton of Pendelton Legal Services PC to act as my legal representative and conduct business with IRCC on my behalf.
The form designates a paid legal representative to conduct business with IRCC using Form IMM 5475 instead of the required Use of a Representative form (IMM 5476).

defect_spec.description: Form IMM 5475 was improperly submitted to appoint a paid legal representative to conduct business and submit documents, which requires Form IMM 5476 (Use of a Representative).

field_mutations.designated_individual_role: Set to Paid Legal Representative and Authorized Agent

cases.title: IMM 5475 Authority to Release Personal Information - Missing Accompanying Spouse Consent

fields.designated_individual_details: Full contact details and mailing address provided
fields.authorization_scope: Release of personal and family application status information

narrative_blocks: I, Priya Sharma, authorize IRCC to release information regarding application PR0928371, which includes my accompanying spouse Amit Sharma (age 39), to Rajesh Sharma.
The application includes an accompanying adult spouse, but no separate Form IMM 5475 consent or Section C signature was provided for the accompanying spouse.

defect_spec.description: Accompanying spouse Amit Sharma is included on the application, but separate consent/signature on Form IMM 5475 was omitted for the adult family member.
